name: Groovitron – Music
description: Create music with the connected providers, play it and edit it with ffmpeg.
long_description: Creates tracks with the music providers connected in OmniWrench (Gemini Lyria, ElevenLabs, MiniMax, Stability, Mureka, fal.ai, Replicate and more), with or without lyrics. Tracks are played inside OmniWrench on the current default audio device and can be trimmed or converted to MP3 with ffmpeg. On Windows OmniWrench downloads ffmpeg on request (once for Groovitron and Vidcomic).
author: KuroShiro
